history.overview: The Hollows were once Dragorn mining tunnels, later seized and corrupted by Muramite forces.

timeline.name: Mining Era
timeline.description: Dragorn miners carved tunnels beneath Dranik’s Scar to extract stone and minerals.

timeline.name: Muramite Invasion
timeline.description: Muramite forces seized the tunnels and converted them into underground staging grounds.

timeline.name: Discord Ruptures
timeline.description: Discord energy seeped into the tunnels, warping stone and spawning anomalies.

timeline.name: Resistance Operations
timeline.description: Dragorn rebels established hidden alcoves and infiltration routes throughout the Hollows.

timeline.name: Current Era
timeline.description: The Hollows remain contested territory filled with Muramite patrols and Discord corruption.
